title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.31062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Policy enforcement for LLM agents has shifted from single-turn content moderation to compound, application-specific policies evaluated over multi-turn transcripts and tool-call trajectories. Fine-tuned guardrail models are efficient but degrade on compound policies, and while LLM-as-a-judge approaches achieve higher accuracy, they incur high inference cost and tend to produce unstable predictions. Neurosymbolic methods offer a natural alternative, decomposing the policy into narrow neural decisions composed under explicit logic. However, existing symbolic layers lack the required expressiveness and are optimized against fixed data rather than the policy itself. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, which compiles a policy into an executable program of neural predicates executed by small models, deterministic extractors, and code that composes their outputs. translated_title: SCOPE：将自然语言策略编译为神经符号谓词程序
translated_abstract: 针对大语言模型（LLM）智能体的策略执行已经从单轮内容审核，转向在多轮对话记录和工具调用轨迹上进行评估的复合型、应用特定策略。微调的护栏模型虽然高效，但在复合策略上性能会下降；而“LLM作为裁判”的方法虽然能达到更高的准确率，但推理成本高昂且预测结果不稳定。神经符号方法提供了一种天然的替代方案，将策略分解为在显式逻辑下组合的窄域神经决策。然而，现有的符号层缺乏所需的表达能力，且是针对固定数据而非策略本身进行优化的。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SCOPE，它将策略编译为可执行的神经谓词程序，由小模型执行神经谓词、确定性提取器以及组合其输出的代码构成。该程序与其训练数据进行联合优化，使用对抗性生成……（摘要在此截断）
tldr: SCOPE将自然语言策略编译为由小模型神经谓词、确定性提取器和组合代码构成的可执行神经符号程序，并通过程序与训练数据的联合优化，实现对LLM智能体多轮交互中复合策略的高效且准确的执行。
en_tdlr: SCOPE compiles natural-language policies into executable neurosymbolic predicate programs combining small-model neural predicates, deterministic extractors, and composing code, jointly optimizing the program with its training data to enable efficient and accurate enforcement of compound policies over multi-turn LLM agent trajectories.
